text_block_list.name: Rudolf and Others
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What spirit! What sheer power! The 
strongest Umamusume are charging in! Can 
Almond Eye overcome them?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I can surpass it!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I can surpass it! Because I'm the 
strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The final stretch—Almond Eye screams the 
moment she takes a powerful stride. 
Praying her legs will reach out even 
further...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(It's welling up—everything I've shared 
with you is pushing me forward...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: With you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Our eyes—meet.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I wanna wiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's Almond Eye! Almond Eye!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming everything in her past! Now, 
ascending to a pinnacle no one has ever 
seen— she has climbed to the summit of 9 
turf G1 victories!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming everything in her past! She has 
climbed to heights unreachable by anyone 
else!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who could have predicted such a feat?! 
From this day forth, the name Almond Eye 
shall be etched into eternity...!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"UOOOOOOOOOOOH!!" "Almond Eye—!" "She 
really is—the strongest Umamusume!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Almond Eye, are you serious...! Is 
there anyone out there who can actually 
beat that!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! Oh man, I'm getting super pumped 
for this--!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Almond Eye. And—thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Your will has reached unprecedented 
heights.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Fufu. Fufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hey...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted to see the future that 
lies beyond my continued victories, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What do you think of a future like this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I feel the exact same way!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
However, this isn't the end, is it? As 
long as both our hearts are racing――we'll 
keep on running.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
As long as the light in their eyes 
shines—they'll keep challenging! Toward 
the next goal, toward an even brighter 
future!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Don't you agree?
